name: Snake Wheels
description: Wheels of stepped wedges, black to blue to pale to gold, turning the opposite way in neighboring cells.

code.style: --rule: ( --turn: @r(60)deg; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color2), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--rim); clip-path: @var(--rim); transform: scaleX(@calc(round((1 - 2 * ((@x + @y) % 2)) * 100) / 100)) rotate(@var(--turn)) scale(0.92); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--wk); clip-path: @var(--wk); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color3); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--wy); clip-path: @var(--wy); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
